integrity: The upper bound is a complete piecewise-affine boundary argument: four convexity cells handle cyclic gaps up to five halves, an exact two-branch criterion handles larger gaps, and a cyclic phase contradiction excludes three simultaneous strict distances. An exact Q(sqrt(2)) checker verifies all finite cell vertices, the sharp triple, and supplementary rational-grid checks. No independent audit or independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem computes the three-variable James type constant only for the regular octagonal Banach plane and does not classify all maximizing triples or all regular polygons. The comparison with the claimed lower bound refers to the public March 2024 preprint version inspected for this result.
title: Exact three-variable James constant of the regular octagonal Banach plane
